name: Dynamo
description: Dynamo is the leading end-to-end platform for alternative investments, covering deal management, investor relations, portfolio monitoring, fund accounting, and reporting. This connector lets Claude read and act on your Dynamo data, search deals, pull portfolio metrics, surface investor activity, and streamline day-to-day operations across front, middle, and back office.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Dynamo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Dynamo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.dynamosoftware.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Dynamo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dynamo lists 14 MCP tools, including BulkCreateEntities, CreateEntity, DeleteEntity, EditEntity, GetAuditTrailData, GetDaxData, GetDocumentContent, GetDocumentFromHtml, GetEntitiesByIds, GetEntityById, GetEntityProperties, and GetValidLookupValues.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Dynamo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Dynamo in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Dynamo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Dynamo is developed by Dynamo Software, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
